rows.ARS:
Pink blend Shrub.
Registration name: Juanita ® (shrub, Kordes, 1996/2007)
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, 1996).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2007 as 'Juanita'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 1.25". Single (4-8 petals), cluster-flowered bloom form.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, spreading.

Height: up to 32" (up to 80cm). Width: up to 39" (up to 100cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for ground cover. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant.
